page_title: Captions: AI That Edits Like a Professional Editor

sources.entry: Captions - AI creative studio application for creators. #freemium

summary.name: Captions
summary.one_liner: Captions is an AI video editor and generator that turns uploaded or newly generated footage into a finished, share-ready video with automatic cuts, captions, and AI avatars.
use_cases: Turn raw footage into a finished edited video quickly
Create short-form social videos and ads
Generate AI avatar videos without filming
Clean up talking-head footage by removing pauses and noise
summary.what_it_does: Captions uploads existing footage and automatically edits it in one pass: choose a style, and it cuts scenes, overlays B-roll, adds transitions and zooms, and applies music. It generates auto-captions with stylized fonts and can translate and subtitle into 100+ languages. Users can make an AI twin or pick digital avatars, then change outfits, backgrounds, or product inserts with prompts. Editing tools include correcting eye contact, removing background noise, and trimming pauses and filler words, with a chat-style text-to-edit interface for further changes.
notable: AI Edit that automatically cuts scenes and adds B-roll in one pass
AI avatars and AI twins reusable across videos
Chat-based text-to-edit prompts for users with no editing experience
Merged Mirage Studio into Captions; former subscribers access projects there
caveats: Free sign-up, but the best features require a paid subscription
Some features are available without a subscription; full capability requires a paid plan
